name: Boston University
character: The main campus stretches along the Charles River and tree-lined streets, featuring a grassy lawn and architecturally diverse buildings in collegiate gothic, brownstone, brutalist, brick, and glass-and-steel styles.

landmarks.name: Boston University Bridge
landmarks.quote: The Boston University Bridge over the Charles River into Cambridge represents the dividing line between Main Campus
landmarks.look: A bridge spanning the Charles River, carrying street and pedestrian traffic.

landmarks.name: BU Beach
landmarks.quote: A narrow strip of grassy lawn between BU academic buildings lining Commonwealth Avenue and the torrent of traffic on Storrow Drive has been humorously dubbed "BU Beach"
landmarks.look: A narrow grassy lawn beside academic buildings and a raised earthen berm.

landmarks.name: Mugar Memorial Library
landmarks.quote: The Mugar Memorial Library is the central academic library for the Charles River Campus.
landmarks.look: A contemporary concrete library building in the brutalist style of architecture.

landmarks.name: Warren Towers
landmarks.quote: including the Mugar Library, BU Law School, and Warren Towers, all of which were built in the brutalist style of architecture.

landmarks.name: School of Law tower
landmarks.quote: BU has earned several historic preservation awards with recent extensive building renovation projects, such as the School of Law tower

landmarks.name: Kilachand Hall
landmarks.quote: Kilachand Hall, formerly Shelton Hall, is rumored to be haunted by the ghost of playwright Eugene O'Neill.
landmarks.look: A multi-story former residential hotel converted into a university dormitory.
